text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho, the first leg 
of the Classics. Narita Brian felt 
unfulfilled, unsatisfied by only being 
able to race against her own generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Around that time, Hishi Amazon comes to 
declare war. She had already claimed the 
first crown on the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A once-in-a-lifetime stage seems to offer 
an irreplaceable experience. Sensing this 
from Hishi Amazon's demeanor, Narita Brian 
steels her resolve.
